title: Pitter Patter Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Pitter Patter is a 3 BR / 3.5 BA / 8 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. Just a block off the beach, listen to the sounds of rolling waves and the ‘Pitter Patter’ of little feet fresh off the sand when you experience the vacation allure of ‘Pitter Patter’ cottage.
description_expanded: Description61 EAST RUSKIN STREET1 KING, 1 QUEEN, 2 TWIN BUNKSJust one block from the beach, Pitter Patter Cottage captures the easygoing charm of a classic Seaside vacation. With the soothing sound of waves nearby and a family-friendly layout designed for comfort, this inviting retreat is ideal for relaxed coastal living—whether you’re traveling with little ones or simply craving a peaceful beach escape.Prime Location Near Beach & Town CenterNestled among tall trees for added privacy, Pitter Patter Cottage is perfectly positioned close to both the beach and Seaside’s Town Center. Enjoy the convenience of being just steps from the sand while still tucked away in a quiet, shaded setting. The enclosed front porch offers a safe and welcoming space for families, while rocking chairs invite you to unwind and enjoy the coastal breeze.Bright Living Spaces & Updated Coastal KitchenInside, the home’s breezy beach aesthetic carries throughout the thoughtfully designed interior. French doors open into a spacious living room, offering plenty of room for gathering after a day at the beach. The newly updated kitchen features a modern open floor plan with stainless steel appliances and an elongated quartz breakfast bar—perfect for casual meals and conversation.Dining Area with Natural Light & Entertaining FeaturesAdjacent to the kitchen, the dining area is framed by a full wall of windows, filling the space with natural light. Seating for eight makes family meals easy, while added conveniences like a wine cooler and ice maker elevate your at-home dining experience. A newly remodeled half bath nearby leads to an outdoor shower—ideal for rinsing off sandy toes.Comfortable Bedrooms for FamiliesThe first floor is home to a serene king primary bedroom paired with a spa-inspired ensuite bath, creating a relaxing retreat after a day in the sun. Upstairs, two additional bedrooms and bathrooms provide comfortable accommodations for guests. The queen bedroom features a cozy window seat—perfect for morning coffee or quiet reading—while the bunk room with dual bunk beds is a favorite for kids, offering both fun and functionality.Whether you’re savoring slow mornings on the porch or heading out for beach days and bike rides through Seaside, Pitter Patter Cottage delivers a welcoming coastal escape just steps from it all.Need more room, Pitter Patter can sleep four in the rear guest cottage, Little Feet.* 5 night minimum Summer, Spring Break, Spring; 3 night minimum Fall 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES1,784 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spacePrivate Seaside residential beach access at East Ruskin Pavilion, the largest private residential beach on 30AUnbeatable beach proximity with a 1-minute, 315-foot walk to beach accessEast side of Seaside location, close to town amenities and the shorelineFull-size washer and dryer for added convenienceFreestanding ice makerLarge HDTV with surround sound and YouTubeTV available for guest useScreened-in front porch ideal for relaxing in the coastal breezeOutdoor shower with interior bathroom access, perfect after beach daysPeacock Alley linens featuring fresh, luxurious sheets and plush towels throughout the homeFull access to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes included for two-bedroom and larger homes; golf carts are considered a carGolf carts prohibited for non-homeowners in Seaside; special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002146
